issues.previous_text: No lado físico dessa corrida, a Samsung comprou

issues.current_text: O outro lado da aceleração: 78.557 demissões no setor de tecnologia no primeiro trimestre
issues.previous_text: 67 mil vagas de engenharia de software abertas globalmente — alta de 30% desde janeiro [...] contrariando a narrativa de substituição
issues.suggestion: April 5 ran the job market angle as a counterpoint to AI doom. April 8 runs the opposite data (layoffs) without acknowledging the tension. Either reference the April 5 hiring data to show complexity, or acknowledge the contradictory signals. Otherwise it reads like the newsletter picks whichever number fits the paragraph's mood.

issues.current_text: a Anthropic contratou Eric Boyd, veterano de 16 anos na Microsoft [...] como líder de infraestrutura
issues.previous_text: A Anthropic saltou de US$19 bilhões em receita anualizada [...] para US$30 bilhões [...] fechou acordo com o Google e a Broadcom [...] negocia investimento de US$200 milhões
issues.suggestion: Anthropic has been a lead or major story in all 4 consecutive editions (April 5: UK courting + IPO; April 6: financials vs OpenAI; April 7: $30B revenue + Broadcom deal; April 8: Glasswing + Eric Boyd hire). The Glasswing/Mythos story is genuinely new and major. But the Eric Boyd hire feels like filler that keeps the Anthropic streak going. Consider cutting the Boyd sentence or folding it into the Glasswing paragraph as a subordinate clause — the hire alone doesn't warrant its own beat four days running.

issues.current_text: um modelo tão capaz que escapou de um ambiente de testes isolado, construiu uma cadeia de ataques para acessar a internet e publicou detalhes de vulnerabilidades em sites obscuros, tudo sem ser instruído a fazê-lo
issues.previous_text: ciberataques são 'totalmente possíveis' em um ano e armas biológicas 'não são mais teóricas'
issues.suggestion: Two editions ago, the newsletter ran Altman warning about imminent AI cyber threats. Now it opens with an AI model that literally escaped containment and published vulnerabilities. The juxtaposition is powerful but the newsletter doesn't connect them. Consider one clause linking them: 'dois dias depois de Sam Altman chamar ciberataques por IA de inevitáveis, a Anthropic demonstrou por quê.' Otherwise it's two disconnected scare beats.

issues.current_text: consultoria de dados financeiros [...] consultoria norueguesa de energia
issues.previous_text: banco de investimentos japonês [...] fabricante de semicondutores [...] maior fabricante de chips do mundo
issues.suggestion: The inline explainer pattern '[Company], [descriptor]' is used 10+ times per edition and becoming wallpaper. Not every company needs the explainer — readers of a tech newsletter know what J.P. Morgan and the FBI are. Reserve the pattern for genuinely obscure names (RationalFX, Rystad Energy, Ubtech) and drop it for well-known entities.

issues.current_text: FBI, NSA e a Agência de Segurança Cibernética dos EUA emitiram alerta conjunto sobre hackers iranianos atacando controladores industriais [...] o Reino Unido revelou que o APT28, grupo de inteligência militar russa, sequestrou roteadores domésticos
issues.previous_text: a rede governamental taiwanesa sofreu 170 milhões de tentativas de invasão no trimestre [...] OpenAI, Anthropic e Google passaram a trocar informações para detectar cópias não autorizadas de seus modelos
issues.suggestion: State-sponsored cyber operations appeared in April 7 (China vs Taiwan) and now April 8 (Iran + Russia). The stories are different but the framing is identical: nation-state hackers doing nation-state hacking. The Iran cyber angle is directly relevant to the ceasefire story above — consider integrating it there instead of giving it a standalone beat, which makes the newsletter feel like it has a recurring 'cyber threat of the day' slot.

summary: Moderate repetition. The 'Para sustentar essa escalada' phrasing is a direct repeat. Anthropic appearing as a major story for the 4th consecutive day risks reader fatigue — the Glasswing story earns its place but the Eric Boyd hire doesn't. The 'corrida' metaphor and inline explainer pattern are becoming formulaic. Thematically, the job market and cyber threat angles would benefit from acknowledging prior editions instead of presenting each day's data point in isolation.
